description: This is a C source file implementing main functions and utilities for the SSP (Software Service Platform) component, including registration, termination, signal handling, and debug configuration for TDK testing.

methods.name: CcspBaseIf_deadlock_detection_log_print
methods.description: Logs deadlock detection information based on signal received.

methods.name: cmd_dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches commands based on input character, managing bus connection, parameter retrieval, and memory table printing.

methods.name: _print_stack_backtrace
methods.description: Prints the current stack trace to a file and stdout for debugging.

methods.name: daemonize
methods.description: Turns the process into a daemon on Linux systems.

methods.name: sig_handler
methods.description: Handles various signals, logs info, and performs cleanup or backtrace on critical signals.

methods.name: is_core_dump_opened
methods.description: Checks if core dump is enabled for the process.

methods.name: createTdkDebugIniFile
methods.description: Creates a debug.ini file for TDK testing by copying and appending debug settings.

methods.name: ssp_register
methods.description: Initializes the SSP component, sets up configuration, signal handlers, and enters main loop.

methods.name: ssp_terminate
methods.description: Cleans up and terminates the SSP component.

methods.name: tdk_ssp_main
methods.description: Main entry point that calls ssp_register to start the SSP component.
